fullDescription: Renders the user-profile-overview screen in its default state with a GitHub-style top bar, profile sidebar, popular repositories grid, and contribution activity sections using the shared profile overview component.

Provides a reusable presentational profile overview component with explicit state, activeTab, selectedYear, and searchValue props. It includes an interactive header search input, tab switching, repository cards, profile metadata, and a contribution heatmap with selectable year buttons for future profile-based views.
